verdict.rationale: The Phaser Editor/MCP tooling mentions renaming a bunch of objects and reorganising a scene into layers, suggesting some bulk editing capability via AI agent tools, but there's no concrete evidence of true bulk operations across many items (batch scripting, mass asset processing, multi-object programmatic operations) as a core AI-native automation feature. missing for 10: documented bulk/batch APIs or MCP tools for operating across many items at once, evidence of scale (e.g. hundreds of objects), independent hands-on confirmation of bulk operation reliability.
